data.title: Binghatti Skyrise
data.about:
Binghatti Skyrise at Business Bay, Dubai, the latest landmark by Binghatti Developers, is set to elevate luxury living. With three majestic towers and 47 floors of exquisite design, the development offers studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units.

Positioned in the heart of Business Bay, residents will enjoy a prime waterfront lifestyle with stunning views and world-class amenities, just minutes away from Burj Khalifa. Binghatti Skyrise promises a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and urban connectivity.

characteristics_module.title: Experience Elevated Living at Binghatti Skyrise
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Business Bay Location: Nestled in the heart of Business Bay, just minutes away from Burj Khalifa and key attractions.
  • Luxury Living in 3 Iconic Towers: Featuring 47 floors of stunning architecture and premium finishes.
  • Exclusive Waterfront Lifestyle: Enjoy breathtaking views and access to a vibrant, waterfront community.
  • World-Class Amenities: From swimming pools to state-of-the-art fitness centers, designed for a modern, luxurious lifestyle.

image.name: Binghatti Skyrise at Business Bay, Dubai

location_tile.title: Discover Waterfront Living at Binghatti Skyrise in Business Bay
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the heart of Business Bay, Binghatti Skyrise provides residents with a coveted address and breathtaking water views. Just minutes away from the world-famous Burj Khalifa and Dubai’s bustling downtown area, this location offers unparalleled convenience and luxury.

The Business Bay district is a hub of commerce, culture, and lifestyle, with world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options right at your doorstep. Whether for business or leisure, Binghatti Skyrise ensures residents are always connected to the best Dubai has to offer.

  • 8 Minutes - Burj Khalifa
  • 8 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 8 Minutes - Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC)
  • 5 Minutes - Dubai Mall

more_info.answer: The starting price for apartments at Binghatti Skyrise is AED 975,000 for a studio unit measuring 470 sq.ft.
more_info.question: What is the starting price for apartments at Binghatti Skyrise?

more_info.answer:
Studio apartments start from 975 000 AED 
1-bedroom apartments start from AED 1,650,000 for 770 sq.ft.
2-bedroom apartments start from AED 2,750,000 for 1,260 sq.ft.
3-bedroom apartments start from AED 3,750,000 for 1,890 sq.ft.
more_info.question: What are the prices for Binghatti Skyrise apartments?

more_info.answer: Binghatti Skyrise is located in the heart of Business Bay, one of Dubai’s most prestigious and vibrant districts, just minutes away from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa.
more_info.question: Where is Binghatti Skyrise located?

more_info.answer: The location offers unparalleled convenience and luxury, with easy access to Dubai’s major landmarks, world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options, all within close proximity.
